name: BFV Chef Probe
description: Research probe for a Chef Shared Loader version of the Battlefield 5 hit/kill feedback mod. Read-only: it writes bfv_probe.log, bfv_probe_api.txt and bfv_probe_summary.txt into %APPDATA%\Arrowhead\Helldivers2 and changes nothing in the game. Needs Chef Shared Loader 1.0.0 or newer (1.4.0 recommended).
